beats.say: Did you know Raindance became Dave's fourth number one single in the UK?
Billboard says Raindance hit number one on the Mainstream R and B and Hip Hop Airplay Chart.
The track was released on 23 October 2025 through Neighbourhood Recordings.
It featured as the fifth track on his album, The Boy Who Played the Harp.
The official music video for Raindance was actually filmed in Lagos, Nigeria.
Which track from Dave's album is your favourite?
